title: Grammar: Five high-value irregular forms with avoir
subtitle: A2 · Unit 3: Everyday events: what I did

steps.title: Five high-value irregular forms with avoir
steps.body: Unit 2 introduced the passé composé with avoir and regular -er participles. This unit adds five common irregular forms used with avoir and a starter set of common verbs used with être. Learn the whole verb pattern, not just the participle.

steps.title: Passé composé: present avoir + past participle
Five high-value irregular forms with avoir
steps.body:
• Learn the participle as part of a pair: prendre → pris, then retrieve j'ai pris from memory.
• The subject changes avoir (j'ai, tu as, elle a, nous avons); keep the participle form shown in these examples.
• Put a time or order word beside the action so the listener knows when it happened.
• Do not guess the irregular form from the infinitive: voir becomes vu, not voi or voyé.

steps.prompt: Hier, j'___ le message deux fois.
steps.explain: For lire, the past participle is lu: j'ai lu.

steps.prompt: Nous ___ le train à huit heures.
steps.explain: Use avoir with the irregular participle pris.

steps.prompt: Elle ___ un détail sur le billet.
steps.explain: Voir becomes vu: elle a vu.
The irregular past participle of faire is fait.
